question: The 2021 United Nations Climate Change conference, also known as COP26 is Scheduled to be held at ___________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Glasgow.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• COP stands for** Conference of the Parties.**
 
• The summit was attended by countries that signed the **United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC)**, which entered into force in** 1994.**
 
• The **United Kingdom and Italy** collaborated to host the** 26th COP summit**.
 
• Due to delays caused by the COVID epidemic, the conference was held at the **SEC Centre in Glasgow, Scotland**, United Kingdom, from **November 1 to 12, 2021**, a year later than scheduled.
 
• The** goals of the conference **are to:
 
 
• **Reach carbon neutrality by 2050** and keep** 1.5 degrees** within reach;
 
• **adapt to protect communities and natural habitats;**
 
• **mobilise finance**; and
 
• **work together to deliver.**
 
 
 
• COP26 will attempt to achieve the **2015 Paris Agreement's goal **of keeping **global temperature rise to "well below" 2.0 degrees Celsius **over pre-industrial levels, as well as explore measures to keep temperature rises to **1.5 degrees Celsius.**

 
• Various** ways for achieving the goals **of COP26:

 
 
• Promote and improve **sustainable transportation** solutions, such as **electric cars**, to decarbonize the transportation industry.
 
• Build defence mechanisms or switch to **organic farming **to protect and restore ecosystems.
 
• Encourage the use of **renewable energy sources;**
 
• Improve the **energy efficiency** of buildings by employing eco-construction methods, such as **solar panel installation.** ​
